_comment: Frozen 2025 scoring snapshot for tools/_gffl_rules_reconcile.mjs. MEASURED, not assumed (2026-08-22): a coordinator instruction proposed sourcing this snapshot from LG.DEFAULT_RULES.scoring as committed at HEAD instead of the live settings doc, on the theory that the live doc's 2026-08-14 commissioner edit had already moved past the 2025-reconciled rates. Tried it and ran `node tools/_gffl_rules_reconcile.mjs 2025 17` against that HEAD object verbatim: it does NOT reconcile — 1739 discrepancies (1721 of 2497 player-weeks wrong, 18 of 34 coefficients wrong), including basic full-PPR `rec: 1` where ESPN actually paid 0.5/reception all season, every yardage game-bonus (bonus_pass_300/400, bonus_rush_100/200, bonus_rec_100/200) at 0 where ESPN paid 3/4 all season, `off_fum_td` at 0 where ESPN paid 6, and dst_blk_td/dst_kr_td/dst_pr_td/dst_fum_ret_td/dst_int_ret_td/dst_fum_forced entirely ABSENT as keys (scored NaN/0) where ESPN paid real points on all six. LG.DEFAULT_RULES is the code's generic new-league template, not a record of what this family's real 2025 season was scored under -- it was never touched by the 2026-08-13 rules-reconciliation fix, which worked entirely through the LIVE Firestore doc (backup -> masked PATCH -> verified), never through this in-code fallback. This file is therefore the verbatim `rules.scoring` map read from the live settings doc on 2026-08-22 (matching its state since a 2026-08-14 v=8 commissioner edit) -- the object PROVEN to reconcile 2025 exactly (2497/2497 player-weeks, 136/136 matchup totals, every exercised coefficient, RECONCILED/zero discrepancies) -- reproducing the 2026-08-13 docs/gffl.md entry's own result. It happens to ALSO already equal the 2026 target D/ST table (dst_fum_rec 1, dst_fum_forced 1, dst_safety 4, dst_blk 3, dst_kr_td 8, every dst_pa_* 0) -- that is coincidence of timing (the commissioner finalized 2026 rates eight days before this session, and they matched what 2025 was actually scored under), not a 2026-into-2025 leak. Kept frozen regardless of any future live-doc edit, so 2025 always reconciles against the rates it was actually played under.
